title: Nineteen
statementMd:
Alice likes word "`nineteen`" very much. She has a string $*s*$ and wants the string to contain as many such words as possible. For that reason she can rearrange the letters of the string.

For example, if she has string "`xiineteenppnnnewtnee`", she can get string "`xnineteenppnineteenw`", containing (the occurrences marked) two such words. More formally, word "`nineteen`" occurs in the string the number of times you can read it starting from some letter of the string. Of course, you shouldn't skip letters.

Help her to find the maximum number of "`nineteen`"s that she can get in her string.

## Input

The first line contains a non-empty string $*s*$, consisting only of lowercase English letters. The length of string $*s*$ doesn't exceed 100.

## Output

Print a single integer — the maximum number of "`nineteen`"s that she can get in her string.
statementZhMd:
Alice 非常喜欢单词 `nineteen`。她有一个字符串 $*s*$，希望其中包含尽可能多的这个单词。为此，她可以重新排列字符串中的字母。

例如，如果她有字符串 `xiineteenppnnnewtnee`，她可以将其变为字符串 `xnineteenppnineteenw`，其中包含（标记出的出现位置）两个这样的单词。更形式化地说，单词 `nineteen` 在字符串中出现的次数，是指可以从字符串中的某个字母开始读出它的次数。当然，读取时不能跳过字母。

请帮助她求出通过重新排列字符串中的字母，最多可以得到多少个 `nineteen`。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个非空字符串 $*s*$，仅由小写英文字母组成。字符串 $*s*$ 的长度不超过 100。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示她可以在字符串中得到的 `nineteen` 的最大数量。
